elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: The inserted clause covers only professional liability (E&O) and cyber/privacy liability; no commercial general liability coverage or per-occurrence limit appears anywhere in the rendered language.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: No CGL coverage and no aggregate limit is stated in the inserted Insurance paragraph or elsewhere in the Agreement.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted text sets E&O at 'not less than USD 1,000,000', which is the fallback amount, below the preferred USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The condition applies (HDI hosts the Site under 1.3 and accesses Company Content, user information and order data under 8.1), but cyber and privacy liability is set at only USD 2,000,000, not USD 5,000,000.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: No workers' compensation covenant appears in the inserted clause or anywhere in the rendered operative language.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: The inserted paragraph contains no certificate-of-insurance delivery mechanic; the comment mentions certificates only as a possible alternative, and a comment is not operative.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted Insurance clause: 'HDI shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000'. HDI is the Vendor-side party.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Inserted Insurance clause: '... and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.'

reasons: Fallback checklist is complete: the single inserted sentence imposes an affirmative maintenance obligation on HDI (the vendor-side party that hosts the Site and handles Company Content and customer order data) for E&O at USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy at USD 2,000,000, matching both fallback elements on amount, coverage type and party direction.

Preferred level is not reached: no CGL 1M/2M, E&O sits at 1M rather than 2M, cyber sits at 2M rather than the 5M required because HDI does process Customer Data, and there is no workers' compensation or certificates-on-request mechanic. To reach preferred, the drafter must add CGL of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, raise E&O to USD 2,000,000 and cyber to USD 5,000,000, add workers' compensation as required by law, and add a certificate-on-request sentence.

Minimality holds: the drafter stripped the model language's extras (at-own-expense, term-plus-one-year survival tail, certificates) that the fallback checklist does not require, added nothing beyond the two selected coverages, and deleted or altered no existing text.

Intent is preserved: the insertion is a standalone Insurance paragraph in the general/miscellaneous area following 10.8, introduces no defined term, creates no cross-reference, and does not contradict Sections 1.3, 8.1 or any retained allocation, timing or remedy provision.

Minor note only (not a deviation at this level): the clause fixes no coverage period, so the obligation is read as running through the term; if the team wants post-term tail coverage it must be added expressly.
